name: honkai_collab
description: The Houkai Gakuen 2 collaboration (China only): its four maps, six T-Dolls, costumes and fairies, with an English fan translation of the story.
_comment: GFL x Houkai Gakuen 2 (CN only, campaign -14): the CN client's rows for its maps (10043-10046), dolls (1003-1008: Kiana, Mei, Bronya, Theresa, Himeko, Seele) skins (506-508), fairies (1001-1003: Sakura, Kaguya, Chloe), the maps' clear rewards (mission_event_prize_info, for prizes 6043-6046 the EN client has) and the souvenir icon item those give (1193). The EN client already has their spots, enemies, skills, text, story files and art; only these rows were left out. story/ holds a fan translation of the story (TLAnon, game files from Amaryllis), which replaces the Chinese text.

text.fairy-30001001: Deals area damage. In battle she raises many pillars of fire that damage the enemies they touch.
text.fairy-20001002: "Indifferent and nameless, dancing beneath the moon."
text.fairy-30001002: Deals damage on the map. Strikes up to 3 enemy echelons within 2 nodes.
text.fairy-20001003: "Re Mi Re Mi Fa So Mi Mi Re"
text.fairy-30001003: Summons phantoms. In battle she calls up 2 phantoms with their own HP, and damages every enemy at intervals.
